name: Track Findings
description: Deduplicate and persist validated security findings with evidence, ownership, and remediation state.
author: Dyadic
abilities: Deduplicates findings by root cause and remediation boundary
Tracks source fix, release, deployment, and disclosure as separate states
Verifies created or updated records and their visibility
permissions: Requires an explicit request and destination approval before creating or updating external records
Does not place private exploit details in public projects

changes.notes: Adopt owner-authored security workflow with self-contained references and explicit runtime discovery.
Initial Dyadic-native security finding lifecycle workflow.
